Portland General Electric Company Third Revision of Sheet No. 152-1
P.U.C. Oregon No. E-19 Canceling Second Revision of Sheet No. 152-1
SCHEDULE 152
MAJOR EVENT COST RECOVERY
PURPOSE
The purpose of this schedule is to recover costs incurred relating to the 2020 and 2021 wildfire
and 2021 ice storm emergencies and the January 2024 Winter Storm. (C)
AVAILABLE
In all territory served by the Company.
APPLICABLE
To all bills for Electricity Service except Schedules 76R, and 576R.
ADJUSTMENT RATES
The Adjustment Rates, applicable for service on and after the effective date of this schedule are:
